text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe has been plagued by a number of paranormal phenomena, but thanks to an intensive treatment plan, she manages to pass her health check.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My weight… is still fluctuating dramatically… but my performance has started to stabilize.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to you, Trainer… Although, I'm still some way from achieving my goal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Why am I thinking about my goal when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to imagine how her sentence was going to end, but I can't tell what she's thinking.
choice_data_list: Why don't we decide on our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Results-wise, winning the spring Classics might be too much of a challenge. But at the same time, I don't want us to limit our own potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to ask Manhattan Cafe's opinion first. That way, I'll know how she truly feels.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't… want to admit this. I really don't…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But I know what I have to do… My friend pointed at her, so… so…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I have to enter the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho, the race Tachyon is entering.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's not… that I want this myself. It's that my friend is telling me to do this.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She said to run. And that if I don't…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I… don't know what will happen. That's all she said…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she's made her mind up. Looking at this as a trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Doing well in the Yayoi Sho would set us up for the G1. Which means…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Okay! Tachyon is a handful… but she's an incredible racer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's up there with the best… But given the progress I've made, I think… I might… like to take her on at the Yayoi Sho.
